dialogues.speaker: Lugovskoy
dialogues.text: A hunter... Back then, I was tracking a bear deep in the woods. I fought bitterly to bring the beast down, but when I approached the body, I found she was a mother. And her cub...

dialogues.speaker: Lugovskoy
dialogues.text: Well, look at him now. He was just a tiny thing back then.

dialogues.speaker: Lugovskoy
dialogues.text: It's our tradition to bring him back. I took his mother's life, after all... So perhaps when I grow a bit older, when I'm too frail to even pull a trigger...

dialogues.speaker: Lugovskoy
dialogues.text: He will turn on me and devour me. Just like the old saying goes... "He who hunts the bear shall meet his end in its jaws."
